body: In my opinion, it is worth renaming the `line` and `column` fields, adding the `start_` prefix for consistency.
The loop and especially the `is_unicode_identifier_continue()` condition look weird to me. Could you explain the logic?

Likewise, this also seems overcomplicated to me. Shouldn't the column in the parser/tokenizer always be greater than zero? You're trying to add protection against invalid source regions in GDScript, but this fallback logic seems hackish to me.

The loop goes over the characters till it find something that stops it as there is a symbol, space, or tab. Removing that or setting the end.character just to the end of the line would make it look odd as half of your line will be an error and half of it not. I saw it being used in `get_identifier_under_position` in the same script so thought it might be good using it.
Added the change, will push it soon after fixing the other stuff.
Yeah, changing column and line to start_column and start_line does make this look better/cleaner.

`get_identifier_under_position` is somewhat special since it is necessary to do some stuff without fully parsing a script which is quite expensive in comparison. But errors always come from the parser/analyzer, patching up their ranges in LSP code makes no sense. They should be emitted by the parser or analyzer with correct ranges.
Yep, over complicated myself here XD Works exactly the same without those lines.
